name: g7_wide_guard_pivot_own
purpose: Wide Guard is up when the guard user's own partner U-turns out mid-turn (Pelipper's Wide Guard, then Talonflame's U-turn into Salamence): the pivot request of the guarded side comes inside the turn, and the Hyper Voice after it is still stopped (the view extension's WIDE_GUARD on the viewer's own side at a PIVOT, for the replay tracker's coverage).
